name: sha256-peer-reads
build:
git init -q --object-format=sha256 -b main . &&
printf 'alpha\n' > a && mkdir d && printf 'beta\n' > d/b &&
git add -A && GIT_AUTHOR_DATE='@1112911993 +0000' GIT_COMMITTER_DATE='@1112911993 +0000' git commit -q -m initial &&
git tag -a v1 -m rel && git branch topic
probes: git -C @REPO@ fsck --strict 2>&1 | grep -viE 'checking|^$' | tail -2; echo fsck-done
